thread:
sarah_finance: quick sync — we detected a delayed usage window for 2026-03-20 02:00–04:00 UTC that didn't show up in the ledger ingestion. estimated ~3.2M tokens delayed, could impact invoices for a subset of mid-MAR customers. tagging owners: @ana_eng + @mike_ops. can we confirm scope and containment plan?

mike_ops: on it. initial triage shows consumer group lag on the usage-stream kafka topic. looks like a transient network partition in the collector AZ. i'll validate consumer offsets and whether we can fast-forward a backfill.
\sarah_finance: thanks. priority is to prevent any incorrect invoices from going out tomorrow morning. if backfill will push counts late, we should plan credit adjustments vs blocking invoice generation.

ana_eng: root cause: node-sidecar process crashed and the rejoin backoff was long (~25m). logs show repeated `ConnectionResetError` and then consumer stalled. PR with hotfix (reconnect/backoff cap) is in flight: https://git.internal/redwood/p/4287 — deploying to staging now.

mike_ops: good find. for containment i recommend: 1) hold pipeline job that marks billing-ready until we confirm backfill applied; 2) run backfill consumer with `--max-rate 50k/s` and monitor token delta; 3) prepare invoice exception list for impacted accounts.

jon_devex: copy. customer comms: draft a short note for customers on affected plans with clear timeline and credit policy. will need list of impacted account ids from finance. i can push template to /docs/billing/incident-notices.md.

billing-bot: automated: scheduled invoice job for 2026-03-21 04:00 UTC is queued. status: PENDING.

sarah_finance: action items (owners + ETA):
- Ana (ana_eng): finish hotfix deploy to prod + confirm consumer rejoin metrics (ETA: 1758124200).
- Mike (mike_ops): run backfill, produce token delta report and impacted account list (ETA: 1758125600).
- Jon (jon_devex): draft customer notice and internal FAQ, coordinate send strategy (ETA: 1758125000).
- Sarah (sarah_finance): hold/instruct invoice job to pause if backfill not confirmed by 1758125900; prepare credit template (ETA: 1758125900).

ana_eng: deploying hotfix to prod canary now. command run: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/usage-sidecar -n prod --selector=az=us-east-1a` — I'll watch logs for `consumer_rejoined` metric.

mike_ops: starting backfill in dry-run mode to validate offsets and idempotency. will attach small sample output here when ready.

jon_devex: putting a draft notice in #templates and pinging legal for wording. recommend: "We detected delayed usage ingestion affecting invoice calculations for a subset of customers. We will not charge for delayed tokens and will issue credits where applicable."

sarah_finance: sounds right. small note: prefer "no customer will be billed for delayed usage; affected accounts will receive a credit or revised invoice." legal ok?

mike_ops: dry-run results: sample output: `account: acct_9f3, window_delta_tokens: 1242, predicted_credit: $0.14` — format looks clean. full report uploading to s3://redwood-billing/incident-1758123456/deltas.csv

ana_eng: prod canary showed consumers rejoined within 90s after rollout. `consumer_rejoined` spikes seen. promoting to full production now.

billing-bot: automated: invoice job held for 2026-03-21 04:00 UTC per request by sarah_finance.

sarah_finance: OK — next checkpoint in 30m. if backfill completes and deltas reconciled we'll unpause invoices and apply credits where needed. otherwise we'll prepare a manual reissue plan. :thumbsup:

jon_devex: acked and will queue the notice for manual send pending final delta list.

mike_ops: backfill finished. total delayed tokens found: 3,209,842. impacted accounts: 78. uploading final report now.

sarah_finance: thanks team. closing loop later today after bills re-run. please add any follow-ups to the incident board. :white_check_mark:
